about: Route1 Inc. provides engineering and professional services using data capture technologies in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It offers smart communities solutions, such as parking enforcement, wanted vehicle detection, connecting communities, and threat detection, as well as enterprise solutions. The company also provides lifecycle support, operations optimization, automatic license plate recognition operations for parking and enforcement, and rugged devices and accessories. In addition, it offers MobiKEY, a flagship software application; DEFIMNET, a service delivery platform; and PocketVault P-3X, which separates engineering services competitors. Further, the company provides Omnicast, video intelligence for operational visibility, review, and evidentiary support; Stratocast, a cloud-based video visibility; body-worn cameras; and synergis access control. Route1 Inc. is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona.
